Financial Operations Services

The work behind cleaner books

EH Books is a defined bookkeeping and integration service delivered through the EnrollHere platform with active human review.

01

Bookkeeping and reconciliations

Maintain routine records and keep designated accounts aligned to client-approved accounting policies.

  • Record or import routine transactions
  • Categorize using the approved chart of accounts
  • Reconcile bank, card, payout and clearing accounts
  • Flag missing, unsupported or unmatched items
02

Payables and receivables

Prepare the operational work while the customer retains final approval and payment-release authority.

  • Record vendor bills and prepare payment schedules
  • Prepare client-approved payment instructions
  • Prepare invoices and apply customer receipts
  • Maintain aging reports and support routine follow-up
03

Payroll records and monthly close

Connect payroll-provider records to the books and work a repeatable monthly close process.

  • Post and reconcile payroll-provider reports
  • Maintain the routine close checklist
  • Record supported recurring entries approved by the client
  • Payroll processing and payroll tax remain excluded
04

Reports and integration support

Provide routine management information and keep approved systems connected—without implying assurance.

  • Standard system reports and account schedules
  • Organize records for management and advisers
  • Routine setup, mapping and connectivity support
  • Review sync exceptions and coordinate corrections
Human in the loop

The platform organizes the work.
People make it reliable.

Automation handles collection, routing, status and repeatable workflows. People review the records, investigate exceptions and ask for customer decisions where judgment belongs.

01 • CAPTUREThe platform collectsTransactions, invoices, bills, commission activity and customer documents enter a controlled workflow.
02 • REVIEWA person reviewsThe EH Books team checks classifications, supporting records, sync exceptions and unresolved items.
03 • APPROVEThe customer decidesThe customer approves policies, classifications, entries, reports and payment instructions—and always releases payments.
04 • CLOSEThe team reconcilesDesignated accounts are reconciled, the close checklist is worked and routine management reports are organized.
Not do-it-yourself software. Not a black box. A managed bookkeeping and integration service with technology, people and clear customer control.
